definition: `FilteredEssence F admissible Φ x w` keeps Scott's requirement that Φ holds of x at w, but admits only comparison properties Ψ satisfying the fixed predicate `admissible` in the universal property quantifier. Unlike Scott's `Essence`, it is not an AFP definition or source attribution. The same predicate also restricts candidate essence properties Φ in `FilteredNecessaryExistence`.
note: Needed to test a coherent restricted property domain while retaining the original Scott essence in the same module for comparison. Its full-domain agreement is checked rather than assumed; see FULL-FILTER-RECOVERS-SCOTT.
